name: A major (Ionian) — fret 5
position: E shape · frets 4–7, root on string 6 fret 5
description: The reference. Every mode below is this position with one or two notes moved.

name: A Mixolydian — fret 5
description: A major with the 7th lowered to G. The sound of A and G major chords side by side.

name: A Lydian — fret 5
description: A major with the 4th raised to D♯. The sound of A and B major chords side by side.

name: A Dorian — fret 5
description: A natural minor with the 6th raised to F♯. The sound of Am and D major side by side.

name: A natural minor (Aeolian) — fret 5
description: Minor pentatonic box 1 plus the 2 (B) and the ♭6 (F). The relative minor of C major.

name: A Phrygian — fret 5
description: Natural minor with the 2nd lowered to B♭. Dark; the sound of Am and B♭ side by side.
